name: automatic-issue-implementation-planning
description: Assumption-first GitHub issue planning for one or many issues with batch defaults and one-shot per-unit refine. Planning only.

inputs.name: issue-references
inputs.description: One or more issue numbers or full GitHub issue URLs.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Optional target repository as owner/name when not inferable.

inputs.name: pr-grouping
inputs.description: Optional override per-issue, related, or single.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-implementation-plan
outputs.description: Final markdown plan with batch header and per-unit sections.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Failures and unusable drafts; empty when the run completes.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Concatenated labeled assumptions from batch and units.
